Dev: @eslint/js 9.39.4→9.39.5, @sentry/vite-plugin 5.3→5.4, @types/node 22.20.0→22.20.1, @vitest/coverage-v8 4.0.18→4.1.10, eslint 9.39.4→9.39.5, knip 6.22→6.26, lovable-tagger 1.3.0→1.3.1, postcss 8.5.15→8.5.16, typescript-eslint 8.62→8.63, vitest 4.1.9→4.1.10.
